name: Facet
text: Add a single, prominent button labeled “Live Refresh” that toggles continuous playback of the model’s output stream. This keeps the interface lively and lets users watch decisions unfold in real time, which improves clarity and enjoyment. The trade-off is higher CPU usage during active playback; we accept that because the visual payoff for understanding far outweighs the extra load.

name: Pane
text: Pane: A single toggle forces users to choose between static and live modes upfront, risking abandonment if they later need both. Instead, let the stream auto-refresh by default with a small, non-intrusive pause button—users control speed without committing to a mode, reducing friction. Settle this by testing both designs with 5 users each; measure how often they toggle and whether they complete tasks faster in live mode.
